rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Git-output greps asserting exact-N need multi-result fallback.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no git-output grep

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguation, anchors, and decision logic that bind Claude live INSIDE prompt fence.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Reading the fence alone: it identifies the file path, names the files to read, rewrites in place, uses Edit on push-back. Executes correctly on a realistic module-7/. Nearest miss: no fence text says which file is "the sharing artifact" for this training, resolved by "whichever pattern I picked" + branch.md; body L45 supplements, but the fence is not dependent on it.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Repeated Q&A → premature re-edits. Separate iteration from persistence.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Fence: "when I push back on something specific, use Edit on the section I'm pushing back on, not Write on the whole file." The Edit-not-Write element is in the fence.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Wide prompts split by logical move — paragraph breaks = cheapest scan-affordance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Fence splits into four paragraphs by move (identify+critique, rewrite, push-back, report).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Orient saved rule by where it FIRES, not surface activity producing it.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: saves no rule to an auto-loaded file

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body lead-in mirrors prompt's opening phrasing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L45 closing clause "Claude reviews the file, rewrites it in place and reports what changed" and fence opening "Start by identifying the file path ... Review this session and sharpen the sharing artifact ... Then rewrite" share verbs review/rewrite and the file noun.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Declare `permission-mode:` when paste requires specific Claude Code mode.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: behavior does not depend on a permission mode

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verify session boundary before deciding prompt's context-carrying.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: prompt runs warm in the same session (back-references "this session"); the body does not claim a cold boundary

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Artifact-vs-STOP tail ordering — last imperative wins.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: tail is a report, not an ask-and-STOP

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headless-runner discipline — tail every prompt with no-AUQ guard.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: not a headless-runner prompt

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Long-running prompts stream progress — never go silent.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: short in-session rewrite, not a long-running send-off

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A leading-looking line can be a forcing function; prefer the simpler prompt.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no leading-looking line being cleaned up

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Prompt paths match Builder scope.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Builder at training-dir root; paths are single-segment module-7/ and bare names, matching the M2-onward convention. Exercise apt101-take-it-to-the-team produces module-7/jtbd.md, branch.md, absorption-bottleneck.md, technical-plan.md, people-plan.md, assumptions.md, failure-stories.md (L110).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Output shape — trust Claude's defaults, don't pad.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: prompt is long (about one page) but each move is specific; no trailing shape spec appended

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: "Add X and regenerate" is a trap.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: not an add-X-and-regenerate prompt; names integrate explicitly (see 12)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Vary closings deliberately.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: file carries no closing-mechanic choice

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A take-home prompt asks for one bounded build.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: not a take-home prompt

platform_claims_checked.claim: Claude reviews the file, rewrites it in place and reports what changed.
